_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for is_workload. ingest.py's per-format derivations all read THIS. Edit here only.
_meta.pattern_notes: nonworkload_patterns are case-insensitive SUBSTRING matches (ILIKE '%p%' in SQL; 'p in blob' in Python) — safe for multi-word phrases and concatenated product-code/line-item tokens (AWSMarketplace, AWSSupport, savingsplanrecurringfee). nonworkload_word_patterns are small regex fragments matched with WORD BOUNDARIES (\bp\b, case-insensitive) — for short words that would false-match inside longer words (tax→syntax/taxonomy, credit→accredited). DO NOT add bare 'savings plan' or 'reserved instance': those match COVERED-USAGE rows ('Reserved Instance applied', 'covered by Compute Savings Plans') which are REAL workload (DiscountedUsage / SavingsPlanCoveredUsage). Match the FEE phrasings instead (recurring/upfront/negation/rifee).
